analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI edged up from 38.1 to 42.0 but remains in neutral territory. MACD histogram worsened from 11291 to -220, indicating a continued downtrend. Volume at 1.10x the 5-day average is normal. While up 150% from the 52-week low, it's still 57.7% below the 52-week high, with no clear trend reversal signal confirmed.
